description:
Cyrelle's noticed it too: Halcyon Assurance settles its biggest claims by routing them west, past the grasslands, to somewhere that's on no map the Watch keeps. Sit the claims hall until you can lift the routing slate off the counter, follow the trail west, and find out what's out there.

Without getting made. She says that part twice.

fail_on.desc: Somebody made you in the claims hall, and Halcyon knows which face to look for now.

name: Follow the Money

objectives.desc: Sit the claims hall in Halcyon Towers until the routing clerk goes on his break.
emotes: {who} lingers by the claims-hall queue, counting how many payouts route somewhere nobody will name.
{who} reads the same page of a leaflet about accidental dismemberment for the ninth time.

objectives.desc: Lift the routing slate off the counter.
Follow the trail west (follow the green GPS line).
emotes: {who} follows the graded track west until the grass gives way to mirror-polished plaza, and a chrome wall of a place turns its scanners on {who}.

objectives.desc: Somebody at the gate is waiting for you. Hear her out.
emotes: {who} finds a woman in a pale grey coat already standing off the kerb, as though the appointment was in her diary.

objectives.desc: Take it back to Cyrelle in the Operations Room — whatever you decided out there.
emotes: {who} walks the long way back east, and does not hurry, and has plenty to think about.
